message: No detected input validation: The code loads CSVs and processes DataFrames (fillna, dtype casting) but performs no schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards on the ingested data.
No detected untrusted source handling: DataDownloader fetches CSV files from raw GitHub URLs via wget with no checksum verification, signature validation, or pinned commit/revision checks.
No detected label flipping detection: No label distribution comparisons, expected-label-set validation, or label-noise detection tools (e.g., Cleanlab) are present anywhere in the code.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The preparation code only fills NaN values with zero and normalises strings/dates; there are no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or suspicious-input filtering steps applied to the training data.

No detected model integrity verification: No serialized model loading is present in the code, and no hash checks, signature verification, or pinned revisions are implemented anywhere in the shown pipeline stages.
No detected label distribution validation: No code checks class balance, expected label sets, or anomalous training samples before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural-cleanse, activation-pattern analysis, gradient anomaly detection, or any other backdoor defense in the training code.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy libraries (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) or mechanisms are imported or used anywhere in the code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing frameworks (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD, etc.) are imported or used anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: The code uses MAE/MSE metrics but there is no evidence of a held-out test set isolated from training, signed/hashed evaluation data, or multiple independent verification mechanisms to prevent metric manipulation.

No detected input sanitization: No input validation, schema checks, or range/shape guards are applied to user-supplied parameters (e.g., province, date ranges, model hyperparameters) before they are passed to models or data-loading functions.

No detected output bounds checks: Model outputs (SIRD compartments, forecasts, autocorrelations) are passed directly to plotting and display functions with no NaN guards, probability bounds checks, or sanity validation on returned values.

No detected prompt injection defenses: This pipeline uses epidemiological/time-series models (SIRD, SARIMAX, Prophet, TensorFlow), not LLMs, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and are not present.
